* 200 g cooked rice

Document: evaluation-app-08-e1b980f7-ae47-4406-bb45-0333bb5fd202.md
Title: Evaluation Chickpea Bowl app-08 e1b980f7-ae47-4406-bb45-0333bb5fd202
Section: steps

3. Add the already cooked rice and stir for 2 minutes.
4. Divide into 2 servings.
